nodes.label: Generic CRUD Form Scaffold
nodes.rationale: farms/simple_form.html, farms/farm_form.html, farms/pen_form.html, feeding/record_form.html, finance/record_form.html and flocks/batch_form.html are identical: an Edit/Add title toggled on the presence of `object`, an `object_label` context variable for the human noun, csrf token, delegation of all field rendering to partials/_form_fields.html, multipart encoding always on, and history.back() for both Back and Cancel. One scaffold therefore serves every CreateView/UpdateView in the project. history.back() is chosen over a computed success/cancel URL so the template needs no per-model URL knowledge; the cost is that Cancel is browser-history dependent and breaks on a direct deep link. enctype=multipart/form-data is unconditional so file fields work without per-form configuration.
